title: Order XLIII Rule 1 CPC — Appealable orders list

content.overview: Order XLIII Rule 1 is the working list of appealable orders under Section 104(1)(i).
content.study: If the order is not in Section 104 and not in this list, there is no miscellaneous appeal. Use Section 105 in the decree appeal, or revision where it still lies.
